name: Listening Post
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Listening Post turns 29 curated AI-vendor sources into a release radar for Omarchy. Separate lanes surface model launches, pricing and limit changes, status incidents, and engineering posts; same-week release bursts collapse into a readable row. Providers you use float to the top, new installs start quiet, and the bar vanishes when nothing needs attention. Sources are fixed at build time, fetches are bounded HTTPS-only requests, and no account, token, telemetry, or configurable host is required.

barWidget.description: The bar stays invisible until a model ships, a provider reports an incident, or pricing changes matter. Open Listening Post for four keyboard-walkable lanes, clustered weekly release bursts, source health, readable ages, links, refresh, and mark-read controls. Providers represented in your Omarchy Agents usage rise first without reading their files. Twenty-nine fixed sources are fetched over bounded HTTPS; article bodies, engagement counts, custom hosts, accounts, tokens, and telemetry stay out.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify on new model releases and unresolved status incidents. Engineering posts and changelog commits never notify.

schema.label: Rank by agents you use
schema.description: Reads the file names in the Agents plugin usage folder (read-only) so vendors you actually run float to the top of each lane.
